versions.changelog: R20 upgrade 1.1.0: align judgment, evidence and trust boundaries; regression fixes and release checks. Validation limits and remaining issues are documented in the bundled CHANGELOG.md.

Ground-up rebuild for the Claude 5 effort ladder: two-axis sizing (capability gap -> model; thoroughness gap -> effort), session+subagent+advisor scope, check_plan.mjs validates only the deterministically checkable parts; 26 evals in three groups; two-arm live test 9/9 vs bare 5/9.
Add model-pyramid stupidskill for subagent model and reasoning-effort sizing.
2026-07-06 refresh: remove neat from distribution and republish remaining skills.
